thread:
marco: Heads-up: noticed dashboard preset name changed from `cost_breakdown` -> `cost_by_model` in the latest content dump. Console examples still reference old name and the live preview errors.
liz: Ugh. Which page?
marco: The Dashboard quickstart and the tracing-hook cross-link on console/observability. Live preview throws `Unknown preset: cost_breakdown`.
kevin: I can open a tiny PR to fix references and add a migration note. Want me to also add a compact Node snippet for attaching trace_hex? The docs currently only have Python.
liz: Yes please add Node. Keep it minimal, one async example using the official helper: `await redwood.tracing.attachTraceHex(req, "0xdeadbeef")` (or pseudo API).
marco: Also we need a Go example for platform customers; a 3-line snippet would be fine.
kevin: Will do Node + Go. Also found one markdown frontmatter issue: `presets: false` set on a page that renders snippets — triggers the example-sniffer fail.
build-bot: lint/links-check started for PR #9923 by kevin
liz: Can we avoid changing the preset name in the examples? Better to alias the old -> new in the doc snippet: add a short note `# note: cost_breakdown renamed to cost_by_model in 2026-03 release` and provide both examples.
kevin: Cool — I'll add an inline code sample showing both keys and a small YAML example: ```yaml presets: true name: cost_by_model # legacy: cost_breakdown```
marco: Ops asked for a log-migration one-liner to rewrite exported JSON events. Suggest `jq '.events |= map(if has("cost_breakdown") then .cost_by_model = .cost_breakdown | del(.cost_breakdown) else . end)'` — adds compatibility.
liz: Nice. Also accessibility flagged missing alt on `cost-by-model.png` screenshot. Add alt like `Bar chart showing token spend per model over last 7 days`
kevin: Added Node + Go snippets, fixed frontmatter, included migration anchor `#rename-cost-preset` and the jq one-liner. Pushed branch `docs/preset-rename-fix`.
build-bot: example-sniffer job failed: missing `presets: true` on `console/quickstart.md` (line 12)
kevin: Fixed frontmatter on that page. Re-pushed.
build-bot: all checks passed for PR #9923
ops-bot: Please coordinate with infra for a redirect from `/presets/cost_breakdown` -> `/presets/cost_by_model` if possible.
marco: Filed infra ticket INF-2719 and linked in the PR.
liz: Quick tech review done, spacing nit in Go snippet but fine to merge.
kevin: Merged PR #9923. Follow-up issue filed to add a full migration script and test harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4088
marco: Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
